html:
The Battle of Vukovar was an 87 day siege of the town of Vukovar on the Danube in eastern Croatia by the Yugoslav army and Serb paramilitaries in 1991.

A few thousand Croatian defenders held out against a much larger force with tanks and artillery. The town was almost entirely destroyed, the worst destruction in Europe since World War II. After it fell on 18 November, more than 200 wounded and prisoners were taken from the hospital and shot at Ovčara farm, one of the crimes later tried at The Hague. Thousands of Croats and other non Serbs were expelled. Vukovar became a symbol of suffering in Croatia, and its fall marked the height of Serb gains in the war.
sum: The Battle of Vukovar was an 87 day siege of the town of Vukovar on the Danube in eastern Croatia by the Yugoslav army and Serb paramilitaries in 1991.
